title: Zoom through
description: Old scene zooms past the camera while the new one settles in; use to dive into a new topic or detail.
props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; zoom?: number /*3*/; maxBlur?: number /*12*/}
example:
import {ZoomThrough} from './blocks/zoom-through/ZoomThrough.tsx';
<ZoomThrough from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} zoom={3} />
